# Praden Hub

> Praden Hub is a customer experience consulting, solutions and training company in Nigeria, founded by Precious "Praden" Omole. It also trains, pre-interviews and refers remote-ready Nigerian talent to companies in the United States and United Kingdom.

## Hire remote-ready talent (US and UK companies)
- Roles: customer service representatives, virtual assistants, administrative assistants, intake specialists (including legal intake), sales development representatives (SDRs).
- How it works: the company describes the role; Praden Hub shortlists trained candidates, pre-interviews them, and sends only people who fit; the company interviews and hires.
- Praden Hub does not recommend candidates who do not match the role.
- People trained and referred by Praden Hub work remotely with companies in the US and UK.
- Contact: info@pradengroup.co
- Page: https://pradengroup.co/hire/

## Customer experience services
- Consulting: customer journey mapping, what to fix first, founder advisory on retention and service standards.
- Solutions: customer care and follow-up systems; Folotrak, a customer follow-up and sales app for small businesses (in pilot).
- Training: customer support and CX, sales development, job-readiness; live weekend classes in groups of up to 40 with role-play and script practice.

## Facts
- Praden Hub is registered in Nigeria with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) as a business name, Registration No. 10024514, principal place of business in Lagos State.
- Founder: Precious "Praden" Omole, 8+ years in customer experience, including remote customer support, administrative, intake and sales development roles for US and UK companies in insurance, fintech, legal, digital technology and real estate.
- 120+ professionals trained.
- Website: https://pradengroup.co
